notes.title: Update 1.0.4 - December 23, 2023
notes.content:
+ Added a hold-to-confirm function when returning to the main menu from gameplay.
+ Increased initial scaling for Alluring Bone to make its effect better felt.
+ Added a new enemy type.
+ Behavior of Necromancers is implemented as intended (spawns the new enemy type to attack).

- Possibly fixed a rare crash caused by Light Volt & Peace Branch.

~ Successfully tested fullscreen in 1440p & 2160p when running the game through Proton & via Wayland. Please post if you find any issues with higher resolutions in native Windows.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3 - December 22, 2023
notes.content: - Zanzibart will no longer spawn infinitely and crash the game.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 - December 22, 2023
notes.content:
+ ZANZIBART will now spawn at the end of "Z'S CASTLE" as intended, allowing the game to be beaten.
+ Fixed some inappropriately high enemy HP values.

~ Investigating issues with fullscreen on monitors bigger than 1080p. Please post in the discussions if you're encountering this issue.
